weather.ask: ^(?:hey )?(?:what s the weather(?: like)?|whats the weather(?: like)?|how s the weather|hows the weather|what is the weather(?: like)?|(?:the )?weather|will it rain|is it going to rain|is it (?:cold|hot)|what s the temperature|whats the temperature)(?: (?:today|tomorrow|the day after tomorrow))?(?: (?:in|for) (?P<city>.+?))?(?: (?:today|tomorrow))?$

speech.weather_day: {when} in {place}, between {low} and {high} degrees, {sky}, with a {rain}% chance of rain.
speech.rain_no: {when} it doesn't look like rain in {place}: {rain}%.
speech.weather_where: Tell me which city: set it in the settings («location»), or ask «the weather in London».
speech.weather_failed: I couldn't check the weather right now.
speech.weather_rest_of_today: Today, between {low} and {high} degrees, {sky}, with a {rain}% chance of rain.
